_sourceListComment: The monitor has no DDC/CI, so inputs are chosen by driving the on-screen
Source list with remote keys. 'index' is the position from the TOP of that
list. The list does not wrap, so the switcher homes to the top with
repeated KEY_UP presses and then steps down 'index' times.

_comment: Devices that live behind the Lemorele switch. If ANY of them is present
on this PC, the keyboard and mouse are here. Matching is a
case-insensitive prefix match against present USB device instance IDs.
Pick IDs that are unambiguous. 'USB\VID_05E3&PID_0610' would be a bad
sentinel on this machine because three identical Genesys Logic hubs are
attached and only one of them belongs to the switch - the prefix would
always match and the switch would never appear to move.
Entries ending in a serial number (the keyboard below) survive being
re-plugged into a different port. Entries ending in a port path do not.
Run tools\Find-UsbSentinel.ps1 to regenerate this list.
